purpose: Serialize the already-selected P512 real frames without re-running the endpoint, sampler, or any supervised operation.

channels.name: pocket_geometric_com_distance_A
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column written by scripts/koff_ml/reference_features.py
channels.meaning: Geometric center distance between ligand heavy atoms and the frozen pocket heavy atoms under the public PBC treatment.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater geometric separation from the pocket.

channels.name: native_contact_fraction
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column; frozen frame-1 native pocket contacts at the public 4.5-A cutoff
channels.meaning: Fraction of the frozen native pocket-contact residues that remain in contact in the current dense saved frame.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater retention of the initial contact network.

channels.name: contact_formation_fraction
channels.source: dense contact_formations divided by the number of frozen pocket contact-bit columns
channels.meaning: Fraction of frozen pocket residue contact bits changing from absent to present relative to the immediately preceding dense saved frame; frame 1 is zero. It is not recomputed between nonconsecutive P512 frames.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate more local contact formation at that dense-frame transition.

channels.name: contact_break_fraction
channels.source: dense contact_breaks divided by the number of frozen pocket contact-bit columns
channels.meaning: Fraction of frozen pocket residue contact bits changing from present to absent relative to the immediately preceding dense saved frame; frame 1 is zero. It is not recomputed between nonconsecutive P512 frames.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate more local contact loss at that dense-frame transition.

channels.name: pose__aligned_ligand_rmsd_A
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column after frozen-pocket Kabsch alignment
channels.meaning: Ligand heavy-atom pose RMSD relative to the bound reference after aligning the frozen pocket.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater pose displacement or conformational change after pocket alignment.

channels.name: pose__aligned_centroid_displacement_A
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column after frozen-pocket Kabsch alignment
channels.meaning: Ligand heavy-atom centroid displacement from the bound reference after aligning the frozen pocket.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater displacement from the bound pose.

channels.name: pose__ligand_internal_conformation_rmsd_A
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column from ligand-centered heavy-atom coordinates
channels.meaning: Ligand internal-conformation RMSD relative to the bound reference, separated from rigid translation.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater internal conformational change.

channels.name: pose__pocket_alignment_rmsd_A
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column from the frozen-pocket alignment
channels.meaning: RMSD of the frozen pocket heavy atoms after alignment to the bound reference.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater pocket deformation or a less reference-like alignment geometry.

channels.name: global__protein_min_heavy_distance_A
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column using the minimum ligand-to-whole-protein heavy-atom distance
channels.meaning: Minimum heavy-atom distance between the ligand and any standard-protein residue in the current frame.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate greater whole-protein clearance.

channels.name: global__protein_contact_residue_count
channels.source: dense reference_features.csv column using the public 4.5-A ligand-heavy-atom contact cutoff
channels.meaning: Number of standard-protein residues contacting the ligand in the current frame.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate contact with more protein residues.

channels.name: pocket_contact_fraction
channels.source: mean of the frozen pocket contact-bit columns in the current dense saved frame
channels.meaning: Fraction of all frozen pocket residues that contact the ligand at the public 4.5-A cutoff.
channels.direction: Larger values indicate broader current contact with the frozen pocket.

input_authority.selection_table_compatibility: A 512-row P512-only table is accepted directly. If a method column is present, the serializer selects exactly method=P512 before applying the 512-row contract; selection_rank0, when present, must be exactly 0..511.
selection_requirements: exactly 512 rows per route after the frozen P512 filter
source_index0 is unique and strictly increasing
first and endpoint P512 frames are retained
no confirmation-tail or post-exit frame is added

missing_value_policy: No imputation. Any missing or non-finite channel, missing route, wrong shape, or identity mismatch rejects the route and therefore the three-replica system payload.
audit_metadata: trajectory protocol compatibility status supplied by the candidate ledger

shuffled_control.permutation_scope: one fixed permutation per system and replica
shuffled_control.algorithm: For each p512 rank i, compute SHA256 over UTF-8 contract_id, NUL, seed, NUL, system_id, NUL, replica_id, NUL, i. Sort ranks by the 32 digest bytes and then by i. The sorted rank list is permutation_index0; H[position] = O[permutation_index0[position]].
shuffled_control.permutation_sha256_encoding: SHA256 over permutation_index0 encoded as 512 little-endian signed-int64 values in C order

fold_local_modeling_rule.training_scaler: Within each outer exact-ligand LOGO fold, fit one per-channel mean and standard deviation using ordered sequences from outer-training systems only. Use scale 1.0 for a training standard deviation at or below 1e-12.
fold_local_modeling_rule.matched_arms: Apply that same outer-training scaler to ordered, shuffled, and outer-test sequences. Do not select channels or fit a second scaler for H.

scientific_boundaries.comment: A future ordered-versus-shuffled result can address information tied to P512 path order only. It cannot establish unbiased time kinetics.
